text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the installation of Heavy Vehicles Prohibitions on Mondeo Drive between Ellesmere Road and Florina Boulevard, and on Florina Boulevard between Mondeo Drive and Birchmount Road. Currently, there are no such prohibitions in effect.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited heavy vehicles at all times on Mondeo Drive, between Ellesmere Road and Florina Boulevard. 2. Prohibited heavy vehicles at all times on Florina Boulevard, between Mondeo Drive and Birchmount Road.
